pages.title: Traces of intangibility
pages.text: “Even one who no longer feels the ground beneath their feet may need armor.”$(br2)The Leggings of the Beyond are the lower piece of the Ghost’s special armor set.

pages.title: Speed of the dead
pages.text: Each kill increases your movement speed for $(thing)3 seconds$(). Use this brief burst to escape or move on to your next target.
